error.security.applicationSecretKeyFile..zh-CN: 应用密钥文件路径不能为空
error.security.applicationSecretKeyFile..en: The application key file path must not be empty.

error.security.applicationSecretKeyFile..zh-CN: 应用密钥文件无法读取或创建，请检查目录权限：{0}
error.security.applicationSecretKeyFile..en: The application key file could not be read or created. Check directory permissions: {0}

error.security.applicationSecretKeyFile..zh-CN: 应用密钥文件内容超出允许大小
error.security.applicationSecretKeyFile..en: The application key file exceeds the allowed size.

error.security.applicationSecretKeyFile..zh-CN: 应用密钥文件不完整，请恢复原文件，不能用新密钥覆盖
error.security.applicationSecretKeyFile..en: The application key file is incomplete. Restore the original file; do not overwrite it with new keys.

error.security.applicationSecretKeys.ini.zh-CN: 内容加密密钥版本格式不正确
error.security.applicationSecretKeys.ini.en: The content encryption key version format is invalid.

error.security.applicationSecretKeys.dec.zh-CN: 内容加密密钥配置格式不正确
error.security.applicationSecretKeys.dec.en: The content encryption key configuration format is invalid.

error.security.applicationSecretKeys.enc.zh-CN: 未找到版本 {0} 的内容加密密钥，请检查 agenteam.security.encryption-keys 和 agenteam.security.active-encryption-key。
error.security.applicationSecretKeys.enc.en: Content encryption key version {0} was not found. Check agenteam.security.encryption-keys and agenteam.security.active-encryption-key.

error.security.applicationSecretKeys.dec.zh-CN: 部署密钥必须是经过 Base64 编码的三十二字节随机值
error.security.applicationSecretKeys.dec.en: The deployment key must be a Base64-encoded random value of 32 bytes.

error.security.applicationSecretKeys.una.zh-CN: 暂时无法提交此操作，请联系管理员。
error.security.applicationSecretKeys.una.en: This action cannot be submitted right now. Contact the administrator.

error.security.productionSettingsValidat.zh-CN: 生产邮件链接地址必须使用 HTTPS，且不带路径、查询参数或片段
error.security.productionSettingsValidat.en: Production email link origins must use HTTPS without a path, query, or fragment.

error.security.productionSettingsValidat.zh-CN: 生产登录 Cookie 必须仅通过加密连接发送
error.security.productionSettingsValidat.en: Production login cookies must only be sent over encrypted connections.

error.security.productionSettingsValidat.zh-CN: 可信代理必须逐一填写实际地址，IPv4 使用 /32，IPv6 使用 /128，不能配置整个网络或任意正则表达式
error.security.productionSettingsValidat.en: Specify each trusted proxy address individually: /32 for IPv4 or /128 for IPv6. Entire networks and arbitrary regular expressions are not allowed.

error.security.credentialSecretValidatio.zh-CN: 请选择支持的凭据类型。
请填写当前认证类型要求的完整凭据，不能使用空值或控制字符。
error.security.credentialSecretValidatio.en: Provide all credentials required by this authentication type, without empty values or control characters.

error.security.credentialService.rotate..zh-CN: 该凭据已撤销，请创建新的凭据。
error.security.credentialService.rotate..en: This credential was revoked. Create a new credential.

error.security.credentialService.revoke..zh-CN: 仍有可用资源引用此凭据，请先替换引用或停用相关资源。
error.security.credentialService.revoke..en: Available resources still use this credential. Replace those references or disable the resources first.

error.security.httpCredentialService.inv.zh-CN: 连接凭据已失效或格式不正确，请重新设置。
error.security.httpCredentialService.inv.en: The connection credential is invalid or incorrectly formatted. Set it again.

error.security.payloadEncryption.encrypt.zh-CN: 敏感内容无法加密保存
error.security.payloadEncryption.encrypt.en: Sensitive content could not be encrypted and saved.

error.security.payloadEncryption.decrypt.zh-CN: 已保存的敏感内容无法读取
error.security.payloadEncryption.decrypt.en: Saved sensitive content could not be read.

log.security.applicationSecretKeyFile.lo.zh-CN: 已自动生成应用密钥并保存到 {}，后续启动将复用此文件。
log.security.applicationSecretKeyFile.lo.en: Application keys were generated and saved to {}; subsequent starts will reuse this file

text.security.applicationSecretKeyFile.w.zh-CN: 应用自动生成的密钥，请与运行数据一起保留
text.security.applicationSecretKeyFile.w.en: Application-generated keys; retain this file with the application data

log.security.applicationSecretKeyFile.wr.zh-CN: 应用密钥临时文件暂未删除，文件位置 {}
log.security.applicationSecretKeyFile.wr.en: The temporary application key file was not deleted; path={}

text.security.credentialService.revoke.1.zh-CN: 撤销未被使用的连接凭据
